objective: Add a reading-time helper so library items can later show an estimated reading time.
requirements: Create src/lib/reading-time.ts with no imports. Export const WORDS_PER_MINUTE = 200.

Export function readingMinutes(text: string): number. Count words as the non-empty pieces of text.trim() split on whitespace, then return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(words / WORDS_PER_MINUTE)). Empty or whitespace-only text returns 1.

Export function formatReadingTime(minutes: number): string returning `${minutes} min read` for a whole number of minutes of at least 1; for anything else (zero, negative, fractional, NaN) return '1 min read'.
Plain TypeScript only (it runs under node --experimental-strip-types): no JSX, no path aliases, no enums or namespaces.
Write regression tests in tests/reading-time.test.mjs; the Factory-owned tests in tests/factory-acceptance/reading-time.acceptance.test.mjs must pass unchanged.
